#### IRAS — GST

**Status:** Evidence verified

**GST input tax on staff medical expenses** (party in scope: Company)
- **IRAS rule explanation:** IRAS states that staff medical input tax is generally disallowed under regulation 26 of the GST (General) Regulations. Subject to the ordinary input-tax conditions, the stated exceptions are expenses obligatory under WICA or a qualifying Industrial Relations Act collective agreement; or, for expenses incurred on or after 1 October 2021, treatment connected with a work-related health risk or requirement and required under relevant Singapore written law. For the advisory limb, IRAS specifies treatment related to COVID-19 and required under a written advisory of the Government or a Singapore public authority. IRAS specifically says Primary Care Plan expenses do not meet the described work-related exception. A claim needs the expense date, legal/collective-agreement basis, work-related risk and mandate evidence, GST registration and invoice facts. [IRAS | Conditions for Claiming Input Tax](https://www.iras.gov.sg/taxes/goods-services-tax-(gst)/claiming-gst-(input-tax)/conditions-for-claiming-input-tax)

**ACRA company secretary appointment and sole-director requirements** (party in scope: Company)
- **ACRA rule explanation:** A company secretary must be appointed within six months of successful company registration, and the position cannot be vacant for more than six months. The secretary must be a natural person who meets the stated local-residency rules. The sole director cannot also act as the company secretary. The secretary is a required officer; check eligibility and residency independently of the appointment deadline. The single-director restriction applies where the only director would also be the secretary. ACRA’s page does not establish an extension or waiver of the appointment requirement. A case-specific conclusion requires: Successful registration date, current secretary, number of directors and which director is ordinarily resident. Candidate’s status as an individual and compliance with local residency eligibility. Current guidance; do not project this page onto an unverified historical incorporation period. A company-specific eligibility assessment requires the officer facts listed above.  The stated registration date reaches its six-month appointment deadline on 15/09/2026. #### Monetary Authority of Singapore — Financial regulation

**Status:** Evidence verified

**MAS VCFM branch establishment prior approval and form** (party in scope: Company)
- **MAS rule explanation:** A VCFM must obtain MAS approval before establishing any branch in Singapore or elsewhere. Row 2 specifies no prescribed form and lists the matter under the MAS-Tx Entity Activities & Particulars category. This branch rule does not determine the row’s separate approval condition for acquiring or holding a 20% or greater interest in a corporation. Confirm that the manager is a VCFM and the proposed or completed activity is establishment of a branch. The approval is required before establishing the branch whether it is in Singapore or elsewhere. The toolkit row specifies no prescribed form; it identifies the MAS-Tx Entity Activities & Particulars category. The toolkit row does not establish the same branch-approval condition for an LFMC or another licence class. The branch approval rule does not answer the separate corporation-interest limb in row 2. The row requires prior approval but does not describe a retrospective approval or late-notification process. For case-specific application, consider: Confirm that the manager is a VCFM. Whether a branch is proposed or has already been established and its location. For a proposed branch, the expected establishment date; no date calculation is needed to state the prior-approval requirement. This rule is limited to the branch-establishment limb of row 2 and does not determine the separate 20% corporation-interest condition. The toolkit is not a complete statement of every VCFM obligation; this row does not describe an application package or post-establishment cure. [VENTURE CAPITAL FUND MANAGERS](https://www.mas.gov.sg/-/media/mas-media-library/regulation/guidance/cmi/compliance-toolkits-for-fund-management-companies/sfa-compliance-toolkit--vcfms29-may-2026-clean.pdf)
